note: Small state park on the east side of East Lake Okoboji near Spirit Lake, donated by Berkley and Elinor Bedell. The campground loop sits on the park's east edge by the county road, away from the lake; paved trails through prairie and wetland and a playground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20/$38 (DNR rates sheet: $38 is the peak full-hookup rate), 20/30/50A full hookups, 70-ft pull-throughs, showers, dump, 100% reservable on ReserveAmerica. Sites 8 -> 7 (the eighth, H8, is the host site). Not waterfront confirmed (~500 m from East Okoboji through woods, park road and houses). Pin ~170 m off (on a farmstead across the road), under the limit.
flags: SITES: 8 -> 7. The DNR map (7/2025) marks H8 as the non-reservable host site, and its ReserveAmerica page says 'Host site: Y'; sites 1-7 are the reservable ones.
HOOKUPS: the DNR map gives 'Full Hook-up (20/30/50-amp)', but ReserveAmerica lists 'Electricity Hookup: 20/30' on all 8 sites. I kept 50 on the DNR map's authority; the catalog may be stale.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront confirmed): the campground loop is on the park's east edge beside the county road at about 43.4129,-95.0677. The nearest shore of East Lake Okoboji (its south bay) is ~500 m west-southwest across wooded parkland, the park road, a parking lot and a block of houses; the lake's main shore is further, beyond the prairie. No view.
PIN (~170 m, under the 250 m limit): stored 43.41180,-95.06630 is on the farmstead across the road southeast of the loop. Better: 43.41285,-95.06770.
